emotions.title: The Qur'an and Human Emotions
emotions.intro: Every human emotion finds expression in the Holy Qur'an. Pick an emotion to see the verses that speak to it — directly to the text, with authentic tafsir. No AI-generated commentary, no generalizations.
emotions.metaTitle: The Qur'an and Human Emotions — Noor Quran & Hadith
emotions.metaDescription: An emotional journey through the Qur'an: anxiety, sadness, fear, loneliness, hope, gratitude, inner peace. Qur'anic verses with authentic tafsir only — no AI interpretation.

topics.title: Topics in the Qur'an
topics.intro: A thematic index of the Holy Qur'an. For each topic you'll find references to the central verses that address it — straight to the text. No personal commentary here; meaning is to be read in the Qur'an itself and in authentic tafsir.
topics.metaTitle: Topics in the Qur'an — Noor Quran & Hadith
topics.metaDescription: A thematic index of the Holy Qur'an: prayer, charity, patience, justice, mercy and more. Each topic with verse references — no commentary, only the original text.

prophets.title: Prophets in the Qur'an
prophets.intro: Prophets mentioned by name in the Holy Qur'an. For each prophet there are references to the central verses where he is named, directly to the Qur'anic text. No commentary or narratives here — to read the story itself, go to the verses and tafsir.
